apps.localizedDescription:
A Gift from the Fox God to the Metal Universe

BMverse is the ultimate fan app for BABYMETAL enthusiasts, offering an immersive experience into the world of the legendary Japanese metal idolgroup. Inspired by the divine presence of the Fox God, the app connects BABYMETAL’s powerful music and messages to fans across this universe. In the spirit of their unique mythology, BMverse represents the bridge between our world and the one where the Fox God sent BABYMETAL to spread joy, strength, and unity to the global metal community.
With BMverse, you enter a realm where BABYMETAL's electrifying music, unforgettable performances, and insightful lore come together. This is more than just an app, it’s a journey through the cosmic energy of BABYMETAL’s music, designed to bring metalheads closer to the band, their songs, and the message of joy, power, and connection sent from the Fox God.

Are you a dedicated fan of BABYMETAL?
This app is designed to bring you closer to the world of BABYMETAL, offering a wealth of features that will keep you entertained and informed.


Key Features:

Music Player
Streams nearly all BABYMETAL songs as previews (provided courtesy of iTunes) or upload your music files from your own BABYMETAL music collection. With your uploaded music you can hear your favorite songs offline anytime and anywhere. From their early hits to the latest tracks, you’ll have access to their full discography in one app.

Customizable Playlist
Create your own personal BABYMETAL playlist! Choose your favorite tracks and organize them to enjoy whenever you want.

Video Player
Stream your favorite Official BABYMETAL music videos in high quality with the integrated Youtube player. There is more to come.

Concert Information
Stay up to date with all the latest concert dates and events! Get information on upcoming tours, live performances, and exclusive fan events, so you never miss a chance to see BABYMETAL live.

Song & Concert Details
Delve deeper into the world of BABYMETAL with detailed information on each of their songs and concerts. Learn about the inspiration behind their iconic tracks, explore their lyrics, and discover exclusive behind-the-scenes insights about their performances.

Fan Community
This app was made by BABYMETAL fans for the BABYMETAL fan community. The app is free. There are no hidden costs. No user data is collected or sold. Join the BMverse Discord Channel and give your feedback to improve this app. We would like to give back to BABYMETAL some of the joy we have received!


DISCLAIMER:
BMverse has no affiliation, association, endorsement, or any connection to BABYMETAL, or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. BMverse makes no claim to and has no ownership interest in any intellectual property owned by BABYMETAL or any of its affiliates. This app has no economic interests, financial goals, or earnings. It is provided solely for informational, entertainment, or functional purposes and does not generate any revenue or financial gain.
